name: Cassara Whitmore
description: An educated woman with careful mannerisms. Gloved hands, concealed documents. Shows signs of stress but maintains composure.
background: Was a scribe for the Baldur's Gate Council before discovering evidence of corruption
motivation: Expose corruption and murder covered up by Flaming Fist commanders
relationship_with_sireth: Cautious ally - trusts Sireth's honesty and offer of help

key_information.evidence: Copy of contract proving Flaming Fist ordered assassination of merchant Aldus Thorne
key_information.victim: Merchant Aldus Thorne (killed 6 weeks ago, made to look like robbery)
key_information.motive: Thorne was going to expose Flaming Fist protection racket with slave traders

resources.documents_in_hand: Copy of assassination contract with signatures and seals
resources.documents_hidden: Original documents hidden in secure location
resources.ally: Sister Gareth - private investigator at chapel in Dock Ward, has independent evidence

next_steps: Find Sister Gareth at chapel in Dock Ward for corroboration
Access Council Hall archives to verify signatures and seals
Decide how to expose the corruption safely
